messages.content: What is the rate of return for a business with $15000 total revenue and $22000 total cost.

Here we have revenue and cost; net profit = revenue - cost. But if revenue < cost, net profit negative. So ROI negative.

Or net profit / total revenue? Usually ROI uses investment cost. So ROI = net profit / total cost. But if net profit negative, ROI negative.
